recipe_coverage: Whole-Oracle adjacent own-return calibration with actual Creature type, printed costs/stats/passives, entry return controlled-vs-owned destinations, source-self or source-excluded semantics, real reentry/costs/counter/replay. Specter real combat hand coercion covers source-controller selection of damaged-player card, land/creature/artifact choices, mandatory refusal policy, empty/one-card hand, blocked and real Aura-granted noncombat negatives. Denizen mass-other return covers all controlled creatures including artifact/land/protected witnesses, original-owner hands, empty/opponent-only and retained noncreature permanents; no target-selector input. Alternative ETB priority/order, token replacements, multiplayer and unavailable planeswalker attack declaration remain explicit boundaries.
